requirement: Return every live antibiotic group as an ID and name pair, sorted by name ascending and read without tracking; soft-deleted groups are excluded by the query filter.

preconditions.text: The antibiotic group table contains the rows seeded for the case
One of the seeded rows is soft-deleted
The antibiotic group table is empty

inputs.text: Query with no parameters over three root groups inserted out of order
Query with no parameters over one live and one soft-deleted group
Query with no parameters on an empty database

returns.text: Success with ApplicationStatus.Success and a non-null result
Groups sorted by name ascending, each carrying its own ID
Soft-deleted groups are excluded from the list
An empty list is returned when no live group exists

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the read-only query has no failure branch
